title: Dashcam Footage Of Police Shootout in South Carolina
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
Two South Carolina police officers involved in the fatal shooting of a drug suspect will not be charged with a crime. The shooting happened last November as Cayce Police Department officers were attempting to arrest a man on drug related charges. Dash cam video of the incident shows the suspect resisting arrest before pulling out a handgun and shooting one of the officers. Officers then return fire, killing the suspect.
